levels.surface: مالك بن أوس بن الحدثان النصري

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad: Malik's account of Umar's hearing (saying 1); Urwa's own report from Aisha, given after Zuhri told him the story (saying 2)
Umar is the speaker inside Malik's story, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5); the Prophet's words inside are not a link
